subject: Urgent: AlphaApps production errors — remediation path & compensation request
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@alphaapps.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: leo.choi@alphaapps.com, procurement@alphaapps.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe 5xx/429 spike — production impact (logs attached)

Hi Kimberly,

We experienced a significant production degradation this morning between 07:30–08:45 PT where ~18% of requests returned 5xx/429 and many timed out. This caused our ingestion pipeline to back up and triggered client-side retry storms. We attached our request logs and a summary CSV showing the error windows.

This impacted our customer-facing flow for ~75 minutes and materially affected our SLAs. Please confirm receipt and let us know: a) root cause hypothesis, b) immediate mitigation plan, and c) proposed compensation for the outage window. We need a response within 4 hours — our CTO is looped in.

— Maria 
Director of Platform Reliability
AlphaApps

Attachments: alphaapps_error_windows_20260728.csv (summary), request_logs_20260728.zip (log snippets)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@alphaapps.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe 5xx/429 spike — production impact (logs attached)

Maria — thanks for the quick heads-up and for attaching the logs. I've looped in Neha (ops) and Marcus (account lead).

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Neha will triage and return an initial root-cause hypothesis within 60–90 minutes.
- We'll provision emergency capacity if needed and push a temporary autoscale policy change to reduce queueing.
- Marcus and I will prepare a compensation proposal based on your impacted window and contract SLA.

Can you confirm the total number of impacted endpoints and approximate traffic during the window (rps)? That will help sizing.

I'll follow up shortly.

— Kimberly
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@alphaapps.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe 5xx/429 spike — production impact (logs attached)

Maria/Kimberly — initial findings from the quick triage:

What we observed:
- Error spike window matches: 07:29–08:46 PT. 5xx rose to 12% and 429s to ~6% of total requests.
- Root cause (short): an interaction between a recently pushed concurrency cap in the autoscaler and a transient kernel-level memory pressure on one GPU node. The autoscaler cooldown was set to 6m, which prevented rapid scale-up for the sudden burst pattern you had. That caused requests to queue, client retries amplified load, and a small number of model shards hit OOM errors producing 5xx.
- Not a data-plane exploit — traffic patterns look legitimate.

Immediate mitigations we've applied:
1) Temporarily set autoscale cooldown to 30s for the AlphaApps pool and added two spare GPUs to the pool (effective 10m ago).
2) Applied a per-tenant circuit breaker to reject requests above a safe concurrency threshold (returns 429 with Retry-After header) to prevent future retry storms.
3) Relaunched the two affected model shards with slightly larger headroom memory params to avoid OOM.

Impact metrics (preliminary, subject to refinement):
- Estimated affected tokens: ~4.1M tokens
- Affected customer requests: ~2,300 unique requests during window
- SLO breach: 75 minutes above the 99th pct latency and error thresholds defined in Section 4 of the SLA.

Next steps and asks:
- We will run a controlled soak for 2 hours on the patched shard and monitor.
- Marcus — need approval to offer a provisional credit while we finish full RCA (we calculate two options below).
- Maria — can you share the rps per endpoint and whether AlphaApps applied additional client-side retries? Your logs hinted at immediate aggressive retries which increased peak concurrency.

Provisional remediation options (for sales/exec approval):
A) Standard SLA credit: pro rata credit for the impacted 75-minute window (formula attached in spreadsheet).
B) Enhanced: 15% of July usage as credit + a complimentary week of burst capacity to AlphaApps for next 60 days (to help migration).

I'll attach the SLO calc sheet and a short grep of the OOM stack traces in a follow-up.

— Neha
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@alphaapps.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed remediation credit and next steps

Hi Maria — thanks to Neha and the team for the quick diagnosis. I want to propose a practical path forward so AlphaApps can communicate to stakeholders.

What we are offering (proposal subject to internal approval):
1) Provisional credit equal to 10% of July 2026 Redwood bill for AlphaApps, applied immediately to your account. This reflects the SLO breach window and is intended to be a fast, good-faith gesture.
2) A follow-up settlement (final credit) after we complete the full RCA within 10 business days. The final number will be one of: pro rata time-based credit (SLA table) OR the enhanced offer Neha suggested (15% + one week burst) if AlphaApps prefers that option.
3) Complimentary priority engineering time: a 2-hour architecture review with our infra team to harden scaling policies and advise on client retry-backoff best practices.

Approval required: Aditya/Marissa — please sign off on the provisional 10% credit so we can issue it today. If you prefer, I can convert that to a fixed-dollar credit (estimated $18,750) — need final sign-off.

Maria — please confirm whether you prefer the immediate 10% or would like us to consider the 15% enhanced offer once RCA completes.

— Marcus
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Leo Choi <leo.choi@alphaapps.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, maria.gonzalez@alphaapps.com
Cc: procurement@alphaapps.com, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation credit and next steps

Marcus / Kimberly — thank you for the proposal and for the rapid operational response. AlphaApps appreciates the on-call support and the temporary changes.

Two asks from our side before we agree:
1) The immediate 10% does not reflect downstream business impact. We request the enhanced offer (15% of July usage + free week of burst) OR a cash-equivalent payment of $28,000. Please confirm which you will commit to today.
2) We require a formal postmortem (public to AlphaApps stakeholders) within 7 business days, including root cause, corrective action timeline, and preventive measures. This should include an explicit timeline for autoscaler policy improvements and memory-guard rails for shard relaunches.

If we get both items committed in writing, procurement will close this out promptly. Otherwise we will escalate to procurement/legal.

— Leo Choi
CTO, AlphaApps
